verdict.rationale: Only community comments show that Milvus offers several index types: FAISS-based IVF indices, a GPU IVF_SQ8H variant, multiple IVF variants and disk-based search. That implies an engineer can choose an index type to trade performance against resources. No first-party documentation in the pack covers configuring index parameters or the recall/latency/memory trade-offs. Missing for 10: documented HNSW graph parameters (e.g. M, efConstruction, search-time ef), first-party index-type selection and tuning docs, guidance on recall vs latency vs memory trade-offs, and hands-on tuning corroboration.
